subject: BLOCK CONTAINS clause
notes: cite.py --check 13.18.10.4 "This clause is required except when one or more of the following conditions exist" -> OK GR1. The managed I-O model writes one logical record per physical record (no blocking), so condition a) always holds and the clause is never required; accepting FDs without it (every corpus program) is conforming, and there is no case where omission must be diagnosed. docs/CONFORMANCE.md A.3 row 5 = Claimed (inert): 'Accepted; no effect on the managed I-O model'. cite.py --check A.3 "The BLOCK CONTAINS clause has no effect if the operating environment does not support the required features" -> OK §A.3 5).
